title: Fire damper ratings.
officialText:
Fire dampers shall have the minimum fire protection rating specified in Table
716.3.2.1 for the type of penetration.
TABLE 716.3.2.1
FIRE DAMPER RATING
TYPE OF MINIMUM DAMPER RATING
PENETRATION (hours)
Less than 3-hour fire-
1.5
resistance-rated assemblies
3-hour or greater fire-
3
resistance-rated assemblies
